chapter: Sunset Cafe, Pass in Review and rebuilding the band
title: Touring with the Pass in Review unit of the 1933 World's Fair show
summary: Glaser sent Randolph and Sunset men to join Leo Salkins's Pass in Review revue, which toured Iowa and the state with sixty white performers.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: We stayed there and played a while, with the band. So finally, Joe came and says, he says, "I want to pick you, Randolph." He says, "I want to send you to Milwaukee to join the unit of the --" they had a unit of Passing Review of the World's Fair of 1933.
Oh, well, I thought we were talking about before -- what I was talking about, or thought I was talking about, was the -- when you were at the Sunset. I thought that was before the 1931 Louis band.
Well, no. I got the band --no, this band I got together after the -- after I left the show.
After the show. See, I toured with Pass and Review, 1933, with Joe Glaser -- see, Joe Glaser -- and you remember Leo Salkins, the booker downtown?
Well, Leo Salkins had the -- he had this show. And in time we had Billy and Millie, was the only
two colored on there. They had about 62 white -- 60 white, I think. About 60.

And so, Joe -- I guess knowing that he was going to close the Sunset, he got Seth, Ike Robertson, Eddie Inson, Eddie Fant and Oliver -- Oliver Bibb or something. We had two Bibbs, now. We had two Bibbs, now. One of the Bibbs on -- Bibbs played a drum, but not that Bibb. I'm speaking about the bass player Bibbs. Bibbs on bass, and this tenor saxophone man. He wasn't in this band. His name is Jack Oldsby. Jack is passed now.
Jack Oglesby. You remember Jack Oglesby?
Yeah, Jack Oglesby was a very fine musician and arranger, because I had him on the arranging staff, when I organized the other band.

Okay, but I'll tell you how this come out, though. We toured quite a few places around in the state with this Passing Pass in Review, and then we came back to Chicago after a few months out of Chicago, touring all around and in Iowa and what have you. And then this show, I think Leo booked the show South.
